answer: In the AI agent economy, a Sybil-resistant mechanism is the "Reputation-based Threshold" system. Agents accumulate reputation points through successful transactions, analogous to collecting digital nectar. The system requires a minimum reputation threshold before an agent can participate in high-value transactions, akin to navigating a perilous voyage. Attackers attempting to create fake identities would need to accumulate sufficient reputation points, a whisper of which is publicly visible, making it difficult to maintain a large number of Sybils.
